doc.title: Suspension of marketing authorisation: losartan 50 mg tablets (synthetic)

revisions.text: The marketing authorisation for losartan 50 mg film-coated tablets is suspended with immediate effect, after an out-of-specification impurity result.

assessment.summary: Reference Agency A (synthetic) suspended the reference approval over an out-of-specification impurity result. CASE-1048 relies on this approval and is in review.

evidence.quote: the marketing authorisation is suspended with immediate effect

doc.title: Label change: clopidogrel 75 mg, new interaction warning (synthetic)

revisions.text: The product information for clopidogrel 75 mg tablets is updated. A new warning on use with strong CYP2C19 inhibitors is added to section 4.5.

matches.reason: The label change affects our approved leaflet. Re-review the leaflet.

assessment.summary: A new warning on use with strong CYP2C19 inhibitors is added. Licence lic-0007 relied on this approval, so its leaflet may need the same change.

evidence.quote: a new warning on use with strong CYP2C19 inhibitors is added to section 4.5

doc.title: Statement of GMP non-compliance: Site 14, Example Country (synthetic)

revisions.text: An inspection found that the site is not compliant with good manufacturing practice. Supply from Site 14 is under review.

assessment.summary: No licence or open case here uses Site 14. Stored with no match, so it can be found later.

evidence.quote: the site is not compliant with good manufacturing practice

doc.title: Recall of batch 22-117: rosuvastatin 10 mg tablets (synthetic)

revisions.text: Batch 22-117 of rosuvastatin 10 mg tablets is recalled after a dissolution result outside the limit.
This notice is retracted. Batch 22-117 was recalled in error and the recall no longer applies.

matches.reason: Retracted by the regulator. The batch was never distributed here.

revisions.text: An inspection of Example Pharma, Plant 7 found that critical deficiencies in sterility assurance were observed. Products made at this site are affected.

assessment.summary: One site failure affects three licences. Grouped into one incident. Two matches are low confidence and need a person.

evidence.quote: critical deficiencies in sterility assurance were observed
